description:
Produces, edits, and repurposes video content for FlashFusion using HeyGen (scripted avatar/presenter delivery), Descript (recorded content editing), and Invideo (written-to-video with stock footage). Routes based on starting material and output intent. Always runs the repurposing cascade after any Descript production session.
Activate when the user mentions: video, record a tutorial, screen recording, Descript, Invideo, HeyGen, avatar, origin story, edit this video, make a clip, repurpose this, turn this into video, YouTube, LinkedIn video, short-form video, video from newsletter, tutorial video, walkthrough, demo video, screen capture, make video content, video workflow, clip this, captions, transcript, Studio Sound, talking head, presenter, or any request to produce, edit, or repurpose video content. Also activates on "I just recorded something" or "I have a recording."
